summary: XPENG Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly operational and financial data, including total deliveries of 62,682 vehicles, revenues of RMB13.03 billion (down 17.6% YoY), gross margin of 20.6%, and a net loss of RMB1.78 billion. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, analogous to a U.S. domestic firm's Form 8-K filing earnings. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. The filing is purely an earnings update, not a transformative corporate event.
